subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, ‘VENDOR’ is written as ‘TMFLGT’. How will ‘CUSTOM’ be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

**First letter if added +2, next letter in subtracted -2 and repeated for next letters in given word.**

‘VENDOR’ is written as ‘TMFLGT’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c5fef16f87072aa4ea5888a26f4d4c2bcb962c14d8e0edece2cc1983f5b0ddb5.png] 

Similarly,

‘CUSTOM’ will be written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d028bacb3ac6dc62395ae9d127d6a2e805072b4068c2584b091ea6da686e9982.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"OMVQWA".**
